726510101.text: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?

726510102.text: Oh, it's... it's you, Traveler! Fancy meeting you here as well!

726510104.text: Come on, it's me, Ulman! We teamed up to look for treasure before, remember?

726510105.text: ...Right, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie! You remember that at least, right?

726510108.text: Sure. Why are you here in Inazuma?

726510109.text: Ahem. So, uh... You remember how you found me all those Iron Coins during our last partnership, yes?

726510110.text: I had them sold off and made a tidy sum of Mora myself... Hehe. Thanks for that, by the way.

726510111.text: But as you know, there're always ways and means of spending Mora. I've quite spent the whole amount by now...

726510112.text: Not to mention how I no longer had a Treasure-Seeking Seelie, so there was no chance that I'd be able to find those Iron Coins without further help from you.

726510113.text: So while I was cooking up some other way to finance myself...

726510114.text: ...I heard from an, ah, acquaintance that Inazuma's a place chock-full of treasure, so I came here to try my luck.

726510115.text: You know this is a closed country, right?

726510116.text: Yes, yes, of course. Well... Let's just say that I have my ways.

726510117.text: Now, where was I? Right. So I made arrangements with those "friends" of mine and got my hands on a boat for a fee. With that, I made ready to sail to Inazuma.

726510118.text: *sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...

726510119.text: And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.

726510120.text: Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.

726510122.text: Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.

726510123.text: And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...

726510124.text: Somehow, I bumped into this little one again, and it helped me find a few treasures, to boot. So I thought, "oh, these must also be Treasure-Seeking Seelie..."

726510125.text: But like the previous bunch, it also got tired after searching a few sites with treasures in them, and now it just circles around me over and over...

726510126.text: It's this sort of Seelie again...

726510127.text: I don't know either. Maybe I'm some sort of Seelie magnet?

726510128.text: Or maybe there's something on my person that attracts them? I don't really get it either...

726510129.text: But either way, now that I'm here, I'm not leaving empty-handed.

726510130.text: According to the information I have, there should still be some treasure around. I've jotted the general areas down in my notebook.

726510131.text: But since this fellow isn't looking too enthusiastic, I'd wager that it would be too tall a task for me...

726510132.text: So, what say you partner up with your old buddy Ulman again, eh, Traveler? Your Treasure-Seeking Seelie should still be raring to go.

726510133.text: Same deal as last time: I'll mark the spots for you, and you'll find the treasure for me. The items you find themselves are yours — I'll stake no claim on them.

726510134.text: But if you find any Iron Coins, just bring those beauties to me, and I'll make sure to give you a good price for 'em.

726510135.text: As long as the price is right.

726510136.text: And it will be, friend, I assure you! We're long-time partners now, you can trust me!

726510137.text: Here, take my notebook. Happy hunting, Traveler, and here's to a profitable partnership!

726510107.text: Right, that's me, Ulman. We teamed up in the past, remember?

726510201.text: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?

726510203.text: You're... the Traveler? Oh my, your timing is impeccable!

726510204.text: Listen, I've got an earnest proposal. A profitable proposal, too. Interested, by any chance?

726510207.text: Ah, come on, no need to be on your guard. Come on, I'm just an ordinary guy looking to make some money in Inazuma.

726510208.text: But of course, Inazuma's a closed country, right? So I got together with some friends to come up with a plan. I got myself a boat that way, and prepared to cross the ocean and get to Inazuma.

726510209.text: *sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...

726510210.text: And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.

726510211.text: Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.

726510213.text: Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.

726510214.text: And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...

726510217.text: A Treasure-Seeking Seelie, to be precise. As the name suggests, they are the best buddies of people who seek treasure.

726510218.text: But for reasons I can't understand, it just decided to quit on me after finding a few treasure sites. Now it just spends its time circling around me.

726510219.text: I've given it some thought, and I reckon that it has gotten sick of my slow rate of unearthing treasure, and is now looking for a new partner.

726510220.text: If you're interested, Traveler, why don't you take up that role?

726510221.text: I'm no expert in Seelie communications...

726510222.text: Haha, it's not an issue, don't worry. I mean, look at this fellow, bouncing with excitement and all — I'd wager it's taken a liking to you!

726510223.text: *cough* Well, more on that later. Either way, wanna try working with this Seelie?
